name: puppet-master
description: Four composable Agent Skills for driving, inspecting, debugging, and profiling iOS apps on Simulator and device.

interface.shortDescription: Drive, inspect, debug, and profile iOS apps
interface.longDescription: Four composable skills that give an agent a closed observe-act-verify loop over iOS: Simulator UI automation, native view hierarchy evidence, LLDB code-state root-cause analysis, and Instruments performance measurement. Every skill reports bounded evidence and distinguishes observation from inference.
defaultPrompt: Drive the iOS Simulator and verify the checkout flow works.
Explain why this button is untappable on the current screen.
Measure cold launch time and compare it against the baseline.
